en: So Colress has gone his own way, has he? He cares more for his questions than for the cause that fed them.
Ghetsis
Well, well. A child, here? Then you shall have the rare honour of hearing my plan from my own lips.
Kyurem is a hollow thing, what was left behind when Reshiram and Zekrom were made. Hollow things can be filled.
With our science, its power will be wound to the very limit, and all of Unova will be buried in ice.
The people will beg us to stop it, and they will give up their Pokémon to save themselves. Unova will be mine!
Shadow Triad
Lord Ghetsis. Kyurem has been moved to the place you chose.
Ghetsis
At last! Then the age of my rule begins. I leave this child to you.
{rival}
{player}! I saw a man in a long robe leave... Never mind him. You! You're one of the Shadow Triad, aren't you?
Tell me what happened to the Purrloin that was stolen in Aspertia City five years ago!
Shadow Triad
Very well. Perhaps this is the one you mean.
I took it as a Purrloin, five years ago. It has grown, and now it obeys no one but me.
{rival}
No... That Pokémon belongs to my little sister! Give it back!
Shadow Triad
Pity the Pokémon, bound to Poké Balls and to whatever their Trainers want. But enough. You will not hinder Lord Ghetsis.
Shadow Triad
Hm. Then try all three of us.
Shadow Triad
Even if we fall, Lord Ghetsis need only win.
Shadow Triad
It makes no difference. You can only watch as Lord Ghetsis uses Kyurem to freeze Unova.
You may have the Liepard back. After what Lord Ghetsis is about to do, I have no more need of it.
{rival}
...It's glaring at me. I finally found my sister's Pokémon, and it doesn't know me at all.
{player}... If Team Plasma get their way, there'll be more Pokémon like this one, and like Kyurem. Go after that man!
I'll stay here with Liepard for now. I'll catch you up, I promise.
{rival}
The man in the robe went somewhere north of the crater, deeper in. Go on, {player}. I'll be right behind you.
Liepard: Grrrrr...
Shadow Triad
